title: ReleaseManifest
description: Schema and template for a pinned release candidate evaluated by evaluate-release-readiness.ps1

releaseId.description: Unique identifier for this release candidate, e.g. REL-WAVE-1-20261001

packageDigest.description: Cryptographic digest of the packaged release assets (e.g. sha256:...)

objectScope.description: List of object identifiers (pages, lists, assets) included in this release. Must be non-empty.

dependencies.description: List of prerequisite components or tasks. Every dependency must be COMPLETE unless covered by approvedExceptions.

testAcceptance.description: Acceptance test results. Every in-scope object must have environment='test', accepted=true, and a non-blank approvedBy.

verifierFindings.description: Verifier matrix findings. All CRITICAL severity findings must have passed=true unless covered by approvedExceptions.

approvedExceptions.description: Explicit sign-offs for known blockers or incomplete checks.

sensitiveAccessChecks.description: Access persona verification. Every check must have passed=true.

recoveryRehearsal.description: Proof of recovery rehearsal. Must be performed=true and validUntil must be in the future.
